lines.en: My steps fall heavier than its.
The crystal on me is larger.

lines.zh: 我的脚陷进矿坑，拔出来。
lines.en: My foot sinks into the pit and pulls free.
My shadow is very dark.
I head toward the ore.
My body carries old wounds.

lines.zh: 我腿上的晶刮着地，出火星。
lines.en: Crystal on my leg scrapes sparks off the ground.
I'm not much of a singer.
Step by step, very slowly.
The grass withers where I pass.
I close my fist.
I stop and listen for a while.

lines.zh: 我站着，身上的晶体在响。
lines.en: I stand still while the crystals chime.
I'm thinking of before.
I don't sing; I only rumble low.
This mine is empty now.

lines.zh: 我一个名字都想不起来了。
lines.en: I can't recall a single name.
That piece on me is slowly growing.
My hand twitched.
It's too quiet here, and it frightens me.
I crouch and stare at the ground.
Something moves inside me.
You're here too.
You're staring at my wounds.
I won't speak.
Stand farther away.
I turn my head aside.
Something behind you is glowing.

lines.zh: 我们上一次也这样对视。
lines.en: We faced each other like this once before.
My hands don't work well.
Don't pity me.

lines.zh: 你退后时，我听见鞋底在抖。
lines.en: As you back away I hear your soles tremble.

lines.zh: 我身上的结晶崩了一块。
lines.en: A piece of my crystal has broken off.
My song was cut off halfway.
I took half a step back and no more.

lines.zh: 从我身上流出来的血是黑的。
lines.en: The blood running from me is black.
A piece has come off my shoulder.
I steady myself against the ore wall.
My song got cut short.
The song I sing has no words.
The wound will close on its own.
I'm still here, not scattered.
Don't offer it to me; I don't need it.
I don't eat; I only want to hold it.
Put it back.
It's too small for me.
I picked up a piece of ore.
This isn't compensation.
The ore in my palm is brighter.
It crumbles to powder in my hand.
Go on; don't stay here.

lines.zh: 我缺的那部分，早就埋在矿里。
lines.en: The part I lack was buried in the vein long ago.

lines.zh: 我的旧伤被你撞得发烫。
lines.en: You knock my old wound and it burns.
I'm sturdier than you.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞在我结晶上，红了。
lines.en: Your shoulder hit my crystal and reddened.

lines.zh: 我拖着的那条腿又吃了一记。
lines.en: My dragging leg takes another hit.
Crystals stand between us.
I caught you once.
A few pieces broke on the ground.
Don't come so close.
Does it still hurt? I heard it.
I won't feel anything.
There's only me left in this mine.
It wasn't always like this.
I remember someone kept me company.
I've forgotten her name.
We were in the mine then too.
The crystals joined us together.
After she left, the mine grew cold.
I kept her stone.
I won't say any more.
Let's keep walking.
I pick up a piece of ore.
It's heavy in my hand.
I press it against my body.
It has grown into me.
I can't lift this.

lines.zh: 梅菲斯特的歌声，从结晶里出来。
lines.en: Mephisto's song comes from the crystal.

lines.zh: 我捏碎它，里面什么也没有。
lines.en: I crush it; there is nothing inside.
I'll give it to you.
Another split opens on my knuckles.
I've set it down.
You've stepped on the seam.

lines.zh: 我把脖子上的晶扭响了。
lines.en: The crystals on my neck grind.
This ore field you entered is mine.
I've locked on to you.
Something is humming under the ground.
You can't walk out of here.

lines.zh: 我的影子被矿拉得又长又歪。
lines.en: The ore stretches my shadow long and crooked.
My fingers lift; the notes arrive first.
I have the position.
You've backed toward the ore pile.

lines.zh: 你喘得比矿里的风还急。
lines.en: You breathe faster than the wind in the mine.

lines.zh: 我抬起的那只手没有收力。
lines.en: The hand I raise holds nothing back.
I don't want to talk anymore.

lines.zh: 你脚边的矿正在往上冒。
lines.en: The ore at your feet is rising.
The ore has started to grow.
I won't sing this line.

lines.zh: 我踩过的矿面都陷了下去。
lines.en: Every ore face I tread sinks.
The cracks follow me.
I needn't run; you can't leave.
The ore wall is behind you.
Two more steps.
Do you hear the crystals ringing?
I tighten my fist.

lines.zh: 我一开口，源石就往外涌。
lines.en: When I open my mouth, Originium pours out.

lines.zh: 你把手中的东西举起来了。
lines.en: You've raised what's in your hands.
I don't go around; I come straight on.

lines.zh: 我肩上的大块结晶朝前倾。
lines.en: The great crystal on my shoulder tilts forward.
One step from the ore wall.
My song is tuned to originium.
There's no exit in this mine.

lines.zh: 矿壁挡住了你的右手边。
lines.en: The ore wall blocks your right.
I swallow that breath.

lines.zh: 我两只手，一只是石头了。
lines.en: Of my two hands, one is stone now.
I'm about to strike.
Don't look elsewhere.
I take the last step.

lines.zh: 砸下去的那只拳头还在抖。
lines.en: The fist I brought down is still trembling.
Crystals push out of my knuckles.
I knock you into the ore wall.
My palm presses your chest.
That blow carried the ore's force.
My fist split open.
I raise the other one.
You blocked once.
There's a crater in the ground.

lines.zh: 我喘了一下，虽然不必喘。
lines.en: I gasp, though I don't need to.
The skin on my knuckles has split.
That fist slid off my hand.
You fell back a long way.
I straighten up and look at you.
We're not done.
I do not run; I simply do not stop.
A section of ore collapses behind you.
I've got your collar.
You broke out of my grip.
The song isn't done. Again.

lines.zh: 我从前面的矿里爬出来。
lines.en: I climb out of the seam ahead.
Footsteps heavier than its.
I carry the marks of older days.
I know this mine.
First I stand still.
The crystals light up, one segment at a time.
I hear a distant echo.
I remember there used to be people here.
I tilt my head your way.
I haven't come out in a long time.
Your smell is in the air.

lines.zh: 梅菲斯特的歌者，站直开唱。
lines.en: Mephisto's singer stands to begin.

lines.zh: 火把源石烤得裂开，我听见声音。
lines.en: Fire cracks the originium and I hear it.

lines.zh: 我从矿顶掉下来，摔碎了一角。
lines.en: I fall from the mine roof and shatter a corner.

lines.zh: 水灌进裂缝，我在里面变冷。
lines.en: Water fills the cracks and I grow cold inside.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀开矿壁，我被埋了半截。
lines.en: The blast opens the wall and half buries me.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我肩上的结晶，卡住了。
lines.en: An arrow wedges in the crystal on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 那股光压住了我身上的源石。
lines.en: That light suppresses the originium in me.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只是在一点点耗尽。
lines.en: I don't eat; I'm simply running out.

lines.zh: 雷打在矿上，我全身都在响。
lines.en: Lightning hits the ore and my whole body rings.

lines.zh: 矿没有了，我一直在往下。
lines.en: The ore is gone, and I keep falling.
